title: Triadic Capital创始人：科技企业发债潮，市场能否消化？
speaker: Monica Schell

segments.en: So you're starting to see some of these big tech companies like Nvidia becoming almost financial players in this whole AI infrastructure build out.
segments.zh: 我们看到一些大型科技公司，比如英伟达，几乎成了AI基础设施建设的金融参与者。

segments.en: Do you welcome the sort of tech-led issuance or do you see red flags?
segments.zh: 你欢迎这种科技主导的债券发行，还是看到了危险信号？

segments.en: Well, you know, I think that the high concentration in developed markets bond when you look at the amount of issuance.
segments.zh: 我认为，从发行量来看，发达市场债券的高度集中是个问题。

segments.en: There's certainly some impact of crowding out. However, you know, one of the things that we notice is that dealer inventory hasn't actually moved that much.
segments.zh: 确实存在一定的挤出效应。但我们注意到，交易商库存实际上并没有增加太多。

segments.en: It's increased some, but not that much, which kind of implies that real money, the long only all-in-credit yield players are still absorbing the some of this inventory that's come out.
segments.zh: 库存有所增加，但幅度不大，这意味着真正的资金——那些只做多、追求信用收益的玩家——仍在吸收新发行的债券。
